title: Proof Freshness Anchor Approval Stop Condition
description: Draft AI governance instance recording that proof freshness anchor carrier and signer trust approval is required before non-stale current proof evidence can support implementation-start readiness.
aiGuidance: Do not treat unsigned payloads, local proof stdout, CI status, generated reports, or untrusted tags as proof freshness authority. Stop until an accepted carrier and trust model exists.
rationale: The proof freshness publication model identifies a self-referential commit-hash problem for committed current proof evidence, and the carrier decision document states that no anchor carrier or signer/trust model is accepted yet.
stopConditions: proof freshness anchor carrier is not accepted
signer or trust root is not accepted
non-stale proof evidence would be committed without an accepted post-merge anchor
anchor payload is unsigned or untrusted
anchor target commit does not match the proof freshness claim
anchor payload digest does not match canonical payload content
anchor depends only on generated report, CI status, or local stdout
driftRisks: stale proof used as current readiness
unsigned payload treated as runtime proof evidence
generated report promoted above proof evidence
